column2: Word has come that [grand_theogonist.GetTitledName] has lost the last of the temple's lands to the swords of [grand_theogonist.GetHerHis] enemies. The Grand Theogonist still holds the high seat of the cult of Sigmar, but not a single field or keep in [grand_theogonist.GetHerHis] own name.\n\nIn every temple of the Heldenhammer the priests are praying for the day the cult's lands are won back, and asking aloud which of the faithful will win them.

The last of the temple's lands are lost. I still hold the high seat of the cult of Sigmar, and the faithful still kneel when I pass, but I no longer hold a single field or keep in my own name. Every heretic and rival in the Empire will hear of it and laugh.\n\nThe priests pray for a champion who will win the cult's lands back. So do I.
Sigmar will raise up a champion.
This shame will be answered, in Sigmar's name!
